ink.role: Page background; text on light pages

raised.role: Raised surfaces, hover and selected rows; buttons on light pages

line.role: Borders and dividers: the assessment's white at 13% over the surface colour

text.role: Primary text on dark surfaces; borders on light pages

textSecondary.role: Secondary text and icons; neutral tint for all grays

teal.role: Primary accent: primary buttons, links, brand icons, completed states

tealDeep.role: Brand borders, pressed states, the highest maturity level

onTeal.role: Text and icons on teal fills

purple.role: Secondary accent: focus rings, secondary links, progress gradients
